items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Lurleen Hunter is playing there... she has a club of her own on the South Side now.

ctx.x: Lurleen Hunter is playing there. Les Strand is playing piano and Parker or something like that, a big black pianist; I don't know. Anyway, he's still around playing cocktails.
Les Strand, by the way, is back in Chicago.
